attributes.title: SPN 37th Annual Conference
attributes.summary:
The Society of Pediatric Nurses holds its 37th Annual Conference from Thursday, April 22, to Saturday, April 24, 2027, in San Diego, California. The meeting brings together nurses who care for children and families in hospitals, clinics and community settings.

The theme announced on the conference page is "Anchored by Purpose, Powered by Community." The call for abstracts closed on October 16, 2026. SPN says registration will open soon; the venue, fees and the number of nursing contact hours had not been posted when we checked.
